map.产后出血预估失血量计算器依据身高、体重与产前产后血细胞比容（Hct）估算失血量，: The postpartum haemorrhage estimated blood loss calculator uses height, weight and the pre- and post-delivery haematocrit (Hct) to estimate blood loss, helping obstetrics judge the severity of postpartum haemorrhage early.
map.产后出血（预估失血量）计算 使用指南: How to use the postpartum haemorrhage (estimated blood loss) calculator
map.产后用产前产后 Hct 变化反推实际失血量，比目测更准确。: After delivery the change in Hct from before to after is used to back-calculate the actual blood loss, which is more accurate than visual estimation.
map.出血量 = 血容量 × (Hct前 − Hct后) / Hct前: Blood loss = blood volume × (Hct before − Hct after) / Hct before

map.正常产后失血上限是多少？: What is the upper limit of normal blood loss after delivery?
map.目测和称重会低估隐性失血（尤其宫腔内积血），Hct 法反映整体红细胞丢失，更适合: Visual estimation and weighing underestimate hidden blood loss (especially blood retained in the uterine cavity), while the Hct method reflects the overall red cell loss and is better for judging whether the transfusion threshold has been reached.

map.阴道分娩 ≥500mL、剖宫产 ≥1000mL 即诊断产后出血；≥1500mL: Vaginal delivery >=500 mL or caesarean section >=1000 mL diagnoses postpartum haemorrhage; >=1500 mL is refractory and needs massive transfusion and surgical intervention.
map.隐性出血（宫腔积血）时用血色素/Hct 下降估算。: For hidden bleeding such as blood retained in the uterine cavity, estimate it from the fall in haemoglobin/Hct.
map.：Hct 由 38% 降至 34%：失血量 = 5000 × (38−34) ÷: : with Hct falling from 38% to 34%, blood loss = 5000 × (38−34) ÷ 38 ≈ 526.3 mL, just past the 500 mL threshold, so start monitoring and uterine contraction promotion per the postpartum haemorrhage protocol.
map.：产妇血容量约 5000mL，产前 Hct 35%、产后降至 25%：失血量 =: : with a maternal blood volume of about 5000 mL, Hct 35% before delivery and 25% after, blood loss = 5000 × (35−25) ÷ 35 ≈ 1428.6 mL; at >=1000 mL this is severe postpartum haemorrhage and needs active management.
